info.title: Secure Upload Gateway API
info.description: Edge API gateway for secure multi-engine file analysis, policy validation, and quarantined upload processing.

X-Request-ID.description: Unique correlation ID for tracing the request lifecycle

UserAuth.description: EdDSA JWT access token issued by POST /api/v1/auth/login

get.description: Answers whether the API process is alive. Does not perform I/O or query dependencies.

200.description: API process is healthy and alive

schema.description: API process is healthy and alive

get.description: Verifies reachability of core infrastructure dependencies (PostgreSQL database and S3 storage) before accepting traffic.

200.description: All core dependencies are reachable and ready to process traffic

schema.description: All core dependencies are reachable and ready to process traffic

503.description: One or more core dependencies are unreachable or degraded

schema.description: One or more core dependencies are unreachable or degraded

get.description: Validates the provided Bearer API key in constant time and returns non-sensitive authenticated application context.

post.description: Validates client upload parameters against application policy, bounds server-side expiration, and creates an upload session.

get.description: Retrieves upload session state strictly scoped to the authenticated application.

post.description: Aborts an active or created upload session for the authenticated application.
Authenticates a dashboard user using Argon2id, issues a short-lived EdDSA JWT, and sets an HttpOnly refresh cookie.
Validates the HttpOnly refresh token cookie, rotates the token, and issues a new access token.
Revokes the active refresh token and clears the authentication cookie.

get.description: Returns profile of currently authenticated dashboard user.

post.description: Creates a new versioned, canonicalized security policy document.

get.description: Fetches policy version metadata and document, enforcing tenant isolation.

put.summary: Update security policy (creates new immutable version)
put.description: Increments policy version (v1 -> v2) without modifying previous immutable versions.

post.description: Evaluates file metadata against active policy, pins policy version & hash, and issues a 10-minute single-use EdDSA upload token.

201.description: Upload session created and token issued

schema.description: Upload session created and token issued

post.description: Single-use atomic claim of an upload session via short-lived upload JWT.

put.summary: Raw HTTP streaming upload into quarantine
put.description: Pipes raw incoming bytes directly into quarantine storage with zero disk buffering. Enforces effectiveLimit = min(policy.maxFileSize, declaredSize), 30s idle timeout, and atomic session claim.

202.description: Upload accepted into quarantine and scan job queued

schema.description: Upload accepted into quarantine and scan job queued

get.description: Retrieves current status and file metadata for an upload session.

get.summary: Get scan job status and security findings
get.description: Retrieves the status, identity binding, and deterministic security findings for a scan job. Requires API key or authenticated user token, and enforces tenant application isolation.
